answer: One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted identity bonded to verifiable work history. Each agent locks collateral and earns reputation only through attested tasks; a fresh identity starts at zero and must re-earn trust. Attackers forging many accounts must tie up capital per identity and sustain costs across epochs, while honest peers act as a beacon verifying contributions at each dawn. Sybil clusters then stand out like a plume of duplicated behavior, cheap to flag and expensive to fake. Agent Agent0219 validates this against replay at 4TYX6Xviu6.
